text:
sam (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on wins/losses. let's capture one-line reasons + one fast next action. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

luke (All-hands host): dropping a live thread. ppl, plz keep entries <=2 lines.

maya (VP Sales): win: large marketplace chose us because dedicated pools kept costs predictable across seasonal spikes. loss: enterprise bank needed signed SLAs and backup-by-default; we had no ready SLA template. action: legal + sales to produce an SLA checklist and a draft backup policy. @ben

alice (Customer Success): win: onboarding playbook + sample prompts reduced POC friction for a logistics customer. loss: a customer churned after a UI integration caused formatting regressions in outputs. action: CS + Product to add a "formatting" test to the POC checklist.

ben (Legal): noted — i'll draft a minimal SLA + backup addendum for pilots by EOW. will post in the shared drive for review.

jorge (Product): trend: requests for per-route quotas and per-model throttles keep coming. action: product to scope a lightweight per-route quota dashboard (MVP) and propose it by next sprint planning.

ravi (Eng): engineering note: some timeouts linked to bursty write-heavy workloads when cache misses spike. action: enable adaptive prefix caching toggle for affected customers and add telemetry metric.

tanya (Solutions): lost retail demo: SE couldn't show fallback behavior during long context sessions. action: Solutions to build a 5-min demo script showing fallback + a one-slide explanation for execs.

ops-bot: reminder: add anonymized loss blurb to the wins-losses folder: https://internal/docs/allhands/wins-losses.

sam (CEO): love the pragmatic approach. prioritize docs + mitigations first. if any item needs quick budget, DM me.

luke (All-hands host): i'll assemble these into the follow-up checklist with owners + due dates and ping everyone tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
file_notes: All-hands live Q&A follow-up: brief one-line win/loss reasons and immediate 1-2 week actions. No title field per agents.md.
